checks: acquisition binds the current S7 WATCH/REVISE or S8 COVER decision, exact specification, topic, source identity, expected SHA-256, media/format and acquisition time
caller-provided bytes must match the expected hash and format; wrong version, stale decision, dropped topic and changed decision during intake do not create a successful intake
post-S8 acquisition may add a distinct source, but changing a source object already protected by the S8 package requires editorial re-review
empty source is recorded as FAILED with no source, rights or structure substitute
partial acquisition is explicitly scoped and cannot imply the unprovided remainder
STORE_BODY is checked transactionally before retaining full bytes; if unavailable, only a pointer/hash and explicit gap are recorded
MODEL_PROCESS is checked before HTML/text structure extraction; STORE_BODY alone does not authorize parsing
TRANSLATE and other later uses are checked against the exact source version through the shared Archive
pointer-only or revoked source bodies cannot be returned as retained originals
HTML and UTF-8 text produce locator nodes with character ranges, text hashes and no duplicated full extracted text in SourceStructure
table and figure regions require original visual verification; table text can be reread only after exact source/use checks
PDF bytes are retained when authorized but are marked parser/OCR unsupported rather than pretending page/table extraction
SourceStructure and SourceNodeRead always record content_verification=NOT_PERFORMED; SourceIntake records facts_verified=false, claims_supported=false and review_status=PENDING
SOURCE_MATERIAL, RIGHTS_RECORD, SOURCE_STRUCTURE and SOURCE_INTAKE are immutable shared Archive versions
SourceIntake preserves creator, institution, language, version label, publication time and data period with the exact source hash
RightsRecord, SourceStructure and SourceIntake all reference the same exact source version; intake also references its editorial decision
re-ingesting the same acquisition reuses exact source/structure/rights versions; a later acquisition of identical bytes creates a new intake without duplicating unchanged derived records
W23 can consume the emitted SOURCE_MATERIAL and RIGHTS_RECORD version IDs and W25/W26 can consume the exact SOURCE_INTAKE version
